reviewAreaResults.evidence: Domain-separated RFC8785 rules define exact exclusions; manifests do not self-list; hash-generation evidence records self-reference exclusion.
Four signer purposes, trust registries, key versions, validity/revocation/compromise and wrong-purpose denial are present.
submissionId derives from trusted producer identity plus validationRunId; replay/conflict/correction and exact verdict endpoint are specified.
Approved account/container/blob/version/ETag/hash/type/size/role plus private RBAC/DNS and WORM copy are required; SAS/URL/public/redirect are denied.
Internal Audit-owned policy, registries, test suite, release/image digests, schemas and limits bind verdicts.

reviewAreaResults.area: Internal Audit-owned assurance software/release package and authority
reviewAreaResults.evidence: WP-05 and DU-16 define ownership and signed release gates; package creation remains future owner-bound work.
Static default and separately authorised ephemeral no-management/no-secret/no-public-egress sandbox are specified fail-closed.
configurationBindingHash and inputManifestHash bind adapter, prompt, model, embedding, safety, chunking, filters and revocation evidence.
Vector records and keys include tenant/case, manifest hashes, chunk/evidence provenance, dimensions and schema.
Hostile-content, cross-boundary, citation, index poison and revocation tests plus known-good alias recovery are specified.
Audit events require producer token/signature/trust verification and final signed body hashing.
Unique tenant/case/sequence, SessionId tenantId:caseId, predecessor validation and no continuity advance for gaps/conflicts/poison are specified.
Receipt binds identity/key/event/body/stream/signer and role-separated reconciler verifies before VERIFIED_CONTIGUOUS/material transition.
Message size, duplicate window, max delivery, dead-letter-on-expiry, TTL/retry relationship and one-dispatcher ordering are assertions/parameters.
17 DUs, five WPs, 170 parameters, 60 assertions, 12 controls, 10 identities and 19 validation entries reconcile; owner inputs remain fail-closed.
17-node/46-edge graph is acyclic; DU-09→DU-16 rationale and six-step activation are stated.
Accessible draw.io/SVG authority overlay is bound and sanitised with title/description and no script/foreignObject/external references.
Phase amendment HTML files are self-contained, parseable, Clawpilot-themed with theme detector first and no external runtime dependencies.
Change evidence enumerates all 19 preliminary findings, dispositions, baselines, superseded preliminary copies and review/approval boundaries.
